about: The Workbench icons of the LTris drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own ltris2.png made 64x64 (art/ltris.png, GPL like the game). LTris-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, LTris.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's LTris.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for README-ltris, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Themes.info is the icon of every subdrawer (themes, themes/Standard).
